_help: Copy this file to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored — NEVER commit it (it holds your bio, brand, and client list). Paths may use ~ for your home dir. See README.md → Configuration.

author.bio: One or two sentences: who you are, what you build, your edge. Every post is grounded in this and must never contradict it.

brand.name: Your Brand
brand.offers: what you build — e.g. web apps, mobile apps, AI systems
brand.vibe: the feel — e.g. precise, playful, no-nonsense
